notes.zh-CN: 新增 Claude 并行上限（设置中限制同时运行的工具/子代理，429 时可填 1），以及网关 429 限流自动等待 30 秒重试一次（已有输出则改为继续指令）。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；Android APK 为调试签名；iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Adds a Claude parallel cap (limit concurrent tools/subagents in Settings; use 1 when the API returns 429) and a one-shot 30s retry after gateway rate limits (sends a continue prompt if the turn already streamed). The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
